editorial_accuracy_note: Goldman restricted advanced coding agent tools for most traders and bankers; not a blanket AI ban. Evidence: Bloomberg Nov 2, Goldman public AI policy, company AI announcements, Reuters.

defect.issue: WordPress core/embed for user-supplied X status returned an anchor-only fallback in content.rendered rather than a native social post.
defect.attempted_repair: Retrieve raw content, replace failed X embed with contextual source link using connected update endpoint
defect.attempt_result: Not applied: wpcom/content-items-update explicitly disallows post type post; WordPress posts-update unavailable in this connected tool session.
defect.next_repair: In WordPress editor, remove failed X embed, add a contextual link to the X post or reinsert a native X block if logged-out rendering succeeds. Save, then check site on desktop/mobile. No republishing or duplicate post.
defect.regression_test: For every newly published core/embed social block, inspect content.rendered for provider iframe/blockquote; a simple anchor-only wrapper fails the embed gate.

learning: WordPress posts-create may accept X Gutenberg markup but render anchor-only fallback; live WordPress readback must inspect actual output and not count markup as working media.
